title: Metamorphic Testing for Detecting Shared Blind Spots Without Ground Truth

original_idea.body:
# Metamorphic Testing for Detecting Shared Blind Spots

Define metamorphic relations (paraphrase invariance, negation flips, irrelevant-detail addition) and apply them across a model panel; a shared blind spot = all models violate the same relation in the same direction. Catalogue cross-model coincident violations. Inference + transformation checks.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 4: strong chain — oracle-free method to surface the hardest-to-catch shared blind spots, a recognized fuzzy-reward eval priority.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: define metamorphic relations + apply across a panel; relation design needs care but the method is inherited.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused deliverable (coincident violation catalogue) with relation construction as a dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: oracle-free fuzzy-reward eval on public models, no internal access, labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: Metamorphic testing for SHARED cross-model blind spots appears largely novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Metamorphic testing exists; using it for cross-model shared blind spots is plausibly novel.
